name: linear convergence and input preservation
test:
import numpy as np
X=np.array([[1.],[2.],[3.]])
y=np.array([2.,4.,6.])
w,b,h=train_regression(X,y,epochs=3000)
np.testing.assert_allclose(w,[2.],atol=1e-6)
assert abs(b)<1e-6 and h[-1]<1e-12 and len(h)==3001
np.testing.assert_array_equal(X,[[1.],[2.],[3.]])
np.testing.assert_array_equal(y,[2.,4.,6.])
print('ok')

name: logistic fit and stable extremes
test:
import numpy as np
w,b,h=train_regression([[-2.],[-1.],[1.],[2.]],[0,0,1,1],kind='logistic',epochs=500)
assert w[0]>2 and abs(b)<1e-12 and h[-1]<.1
with np.errstate(over='raise',invalid='raise'):
 w,b,h=train_regression([[-1000.],[1000.]],[0,1],kind='logistic',lr=1,epochs=3)
assert np.isfinite(h).all()
print('ok')

name: regularization gradients and loss history
test:
import numpy as np
w,b,h=train_regression([[1.],[1.]],[2.,2.],lr=.05,epochs=1000,l2=2)
assert abs(w[0])<1e-6 and abs(b-2)<1e-6 and h[-1]<1e-10
w,b,h=train_regression([[0.],[0.]],[3.,3.],lr=.05,epochs=1000,l2=5)
assert abs(w[0])<1e-8 and abs(b-3)<1e-6
print('ok')

name: constant features zero epochs and early stopping
input: constant features zero epochs and early stopping
test:
import numpy as np
w,b,h=train_regression([[2.,3.]],[1.],epochs=0)
assert w.shape==(2,) and np.any(w!=0) and np.max(np.abs(w))<.1
assert b==0 and len(h)==1 and np.isfinite(h[0])
w,b,h=train_regression([[0.]],[0.],epochs=10,tol=0)
assert b==0 and h==[0.,0.]
print('ok')
